name: Investview, Inc.
summary: Investview, Inc., operating through its various subsidiaries, offers a comprehensive suite of financial literacy resources, digital asset solutions, and supporting technology platforms primarily for individual users. The firm provides services including the management of digital asset technologies, self-directed investment brokerage, institutional trade execution, expert advisory, and innovative algorithmic trading systems that require no coding. Additionally, it engages in cryptocurrency mining, offers repair services, and develops blockchain innovations. Its offerings encompass extensive research, educational content, and sophisticated investment tools, all designed to empower self-directed investors in successfully navigating diverse financial markets such as equities, options, foreign exchange (FOREX), exchange-traded funds (ETFs), binary options, and cryptocurrencies. Beyond market-specific tools, the company also furnishes educational materials and software applications aimed at assisting individuals with personal financial management, covering areas like debt reduction strategies, enhancing savings, effective budgeting, and optimizing tax planning. Originally known as Global Investor Services, Inc., the company underwent a name change to Investview, Inc. in March 2012. Established in 1946, Investview, Inc. maintains its corporate headquarters in Eatontown, New Jersey.
